title: Sharpness and Rigidity of the Two-Factor Recht-Re Lower Bound
summary: Products of positive semidefinite matrices arise when successive steps of a randomized optimization method use different data points. Their average can have a negative eigenvalue even though every individual matrix is positive semidefinite. Lai and Lim proved at ICML 2020 that $\sum_{i\ne j}A_iA_j\succeq-\frac{1}{4}n(n-1)I$ whenever $A_i\succeq0$ and $\sum_i A_i\preceq nI$, and conjectured that the constant is sharp for every $n\ge2$. We give an explicit family of $n$ rank-one matrices in dimension $n$ that attains this bound for every $n$, proving that sharpness statement. The construction…
